description: Adds one item to the plan's shared checklist: one task, ingredient or thing to bring per call. Use when the user wants something added to the to-do or packing list.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character plan ID. Links without a plan ID (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/when) are unsaved local drafts and are not accepted.

text.description: One independently checkable item, single line, max 500 chars. Not a list of multiple tasks/ingredients.

name: add_checklist_item
title: Add a checklist item
